turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick question about the MOTIF hand sensors. I'm trying to map out the data streams for the control loop. What exactly is on the fingertips?
The MOTIF hand integrates dense tactile arrays (6×6, 2.5mm resolution, 20g trigger), 9-axis IMUs at each joint, an onboard FLIR Lepton 3.5 thermal camera, a ToF depth sensor, and an RGB camera.
Wow, 20g trigger is sensitive. Does that mean I need to filter the signal heavily for the grasp planner?
Yes, you will likely need low-pass filtering. The 2.5mm resolution is quite fine, so noise can be an issue.
Makes sense. Also, did you ever order that new mechanical keyboard I mentioned?
No, I haven't ordered anything recently. You might want to check your shopping list app.
Ah, right. I'll do that. Thanks for the sensor specs, Lloyd.
You're welcome! Let me know if you need help with the filtering code.
Lloyd, I'm updating the budget for the robotics lab. How much are we paying for the MOTIF hand units?
The MOTIF hand is built on a LEAP hand chassis and costs under $4000.
Under $4000 is great. That fits within the grant limit. Is the LEAP chassis compatible with our old UR5?
The LEAP hand chassis is generally compatible, but you'll need to check the mounting adapter for the UR5.
Good point. I'll look into the adapters. By the way, is it raining outside?
Yes, it is currently raining in your area.
Figured. Okay, I'll note down the cost and chassis info for the report.
Sounds good. Have a productive afternoon!
